rubric_hint.rule: 3 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Three eligible threatened site-bound forest species recorded 888-999 m from the polygon, none within 250 m: Gyalecta ulmi (EN), Sclerophora pallida (VU), Hydnellum cumulatum (EN); each has lack of continuity forest and old/large trees among its threats.
No records inside the polygon or within 250 m.
Effort within 1000 m is below the county median (20 vs 54 records; 32nd percentile), so the absence of near-site records carries little weight.
Only 1.8% of the polygon overlaps completed felling from 2014, so it is not already felled.

uncertainties: The eligible records lie near the 1000 m edge of the ring (888-999 m), so they say little about the stand itself.
Records are from 2017-2021 and show only that the species were recorded, not that they occupy the site now.
Near-site effort is zero records inside and within 250 m, equal to the county median of 0.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occurs in the notified polygon.
The forest's ecological value or its age and structure.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: A reviewer should check the stand's age and structure and whether it holds old trees or continuity-forest indicators. A field survey would settle the gap left by low recording effort.
